transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this roundtable. As you know, HarborRoute Logistics has breached its quarterly minimum debt-service coverage ratio covenant and is requesting a temporary waiver to cover one reporting period while it completes a contract transition. The existing loan agreement requires a minimum DSCR of 1.20. The borrower has made all scheduled interest and principal payments on time, so this appears to be a covenant compliance issue rather than a payment performance issue. Before I can make a final underwriting decision, I need to hear from each of you -- risk, legal, relationship coverage, and loan operations -- on your assessment of this waiver request. Let's start with risk. What's your read on the situation?
